# Third-party art

## Bomb Party — the complete set

- File: `bomb_party_v4.png` (source sheet for `assets/sprites.png`, built by `tools/build_atlas.py`)
- Source: https://opengameart.org/content/bomb-party-the-complete-set
- License: [CC-BY 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/)
- Credits:
  - Matt Hackett of Lost Decade Games (original sprite sheet)
  - Cem Kalyoncu (expansion)
  - usr_share (complete set expansion)

Changes made: sprites were re-packed into a smaller atlas; tiles tinted by map
themes at runtime (floor, wall, crate, bush) were converted to normalized
grayscale; a few small procedural sprites (shadow, ring, power-up panel,
lightning icon) were added.
